Short answer: we can provide a skeleton team and coordinate a late shuttle, but need to confirm two things from your side: 1) exact back-door badge procedure after 11pm (who will hold badges?), and 2) whether the client will cover the late-night OT for two engineers (we can absorb one volunteer).

Proposed Redwood night skeleton (all on-call/contactable):
- Marissa Cole — lead on-call engineer (9:30pm–12:30am) — responsible for tech resets and floor liaison
- Mateo Alvarez — floater (10:00pm–12:30am) — AV/problem triage, will handle any badge handoffs
- Tessa Morgan — runner/packout lead (11:00pm–12:30am) — assists with last-minute packing and manifests

Grace O'Connor will stay until 10:30pm as scheduled and hand off to Marissa.

Actions for you / Atlas:
- Confirm back-door badge holder name and a phone number (we need someone onsite after 11pm).
- Confirm whether client covers OT for Mateo (we can manage Marissa).
- Please confirm shuttle pickup time/location — we suggest Harbor Hotel lobby pickup at 12:45am for 4 team members.

I attached a quick staffing sheet (nightshift_staffing_sheet.xlsx) and the hotel block confirmation you sent. I'll loop CityShuttle after you confirm the pickup time.

Chloe Martin

- Marissa is local and can stay later if we need an extra set of hands; Tessa's last MGR-approved shift ends at 12:30am and she's ok with that.

If Atlas can guarantee pickup at 12:45am we should be able to get two engineers to the shuttle and one to the airport in time. If pickup slips past 1:00am I need to catch an Uber to reach the 2:10am flight.
